title: Deterministic complexity-based model routing: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL classification from deterministic signals, bounded by the protected controller model allowlist (D-017 amendment)
objective: Implement the D-017-R114..R123 model-routing layer: deterministic complexity classification (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL) from measured signals (files/subsystems affected, dependency-graph spread, security/authorization impact, external side effects, schema/migration impact, ambiguity, prior failures, reviewer roles, estimated context size, packet risk); route only to models already permitted by the protected controller configuration; never let a worker add or authorize a model; never modify config.toml or model_selection.toml; report honestly when only one Claude model is authorized; record every routing decision (task ID, band, signals, chosen model, permitted-model evidence, fallback status, context size, result, telemetry when available); recorded one-level escalation for failed LOW/MEDIUM, never silent downgrade of HIGH/CRITICAL; quota fallback recorded separately from complexity routing; frozen routing test corpus plus CI tests preventing unauthorized/self-selected models, unrecorded fallback, ungrounded classification. If meaningful Claude routing needs a protected allowlist change, finish repository implementation first and return one consolidated OWNER_ACTION_BUNDLE.
business_reason: Owner directive: model choice must be a deterministic, auditable control-plane decision bounded by the protected allowlist, not model self-selection.
risks: Protected config allows exactly one Claude model (claude-opus-4-8): adaptive Claude routing must be reported unavailable, never simulated (D-017-R118); enabling it requires an owner protected-config change via OWNER_ACTION_BUNDLE (D-017-R123).
The router reads the protected config allowlist read-only; it never writes config.toml or model_selection.toml and never touches tools/agent_supervisor/.
Quota fallback (existing model_selection mechanism) and complexity routing are separate recorded decisions (D-017-R120).

progress_log.message: Router+corpus+21 tests+policy+additive model-routing CI job implemented
Self-checks green: 21/21 routing tests; modularity --check 0 failures; supervisor untouched; allowlist read-only
